blocks.title: Edge computing
blocks.text: Edge computing data ko network ke kinare, jahan data paida hota hai us ke qareeb, process karti hai, sirf markazi data centres mein nahi. Is se latency, yaani data aane jane ki der, kam hoti aur tez, foran faisle mumkin hote hain.

Khud chalne wali gariyon mein sensors aur cameras ka data gari ke andar process hota hai, ta ke woh sarak ki halat par jaldi rad-e-amal de sake. Edge computing smart cities, sehat ki nigrani aur sanati automation ke liye bhi munasib hai, jinhein foran processing chahiye (Top Tip).

blocks.prompt: Edge computing ka bunyadi faida kya hai (MCQ 1)? Is ki misal kaunsi hai (MCQ 14)? Kaunsi technology kinare par data process karti hai (MCQ 17)?
blocks.explanation: (b) kam latency; (b) khud chalne wali gariyan; (a) edge computing.

blocks.prompt: Edge computing kya hai aur data processing ko kaise faida deti hai (short question 3)? Khud chalne wali gariyon ko kaise behtar banati hai (short question 8)? Is ki tarraqi aur faide bataiye (long question 4).
blocks.explanation: Edge computing processing ko data ke maakhaz ke qareeb le aati hai. Faide: kam latency aur foran jawab; network par kam data, bandwidth ki bachat; kamzor rabte mein bhi kaam jari; aur hassas data maqami reh sakta hai. Khud chalne wali gari mein camera aur sensors ka data milliseconds mein gari ke andar jaancha jata hai, ta ke woh door ke data centre ka intezar kiye baghair foran brake ya mor le sake. Yeh smart cities, mareezon ki nigrani aur factory automation chalati hai. Bandwidth aur offline wale nukte aam ilm hain.

items: Edge computing: maakhaz ke qareeb processing; kam latency; khud chalne wali gariyan, smart cities, sehat.
